definition: Microchipping implants a small electronic identifier so an animal or other subject can be identified with a compatible reader.
entry_text: Microchipping implants a small electronic identifier so an animal or other subject can be identified with a compatible reader.
example: A shelter scans a found dog and checks its identifier against a registry.
label: Microchipping
sense_note: The common use is animal identification; distinguish implanting identifiers from fabricating microchips.
